description: A 3x3 open grid built so the lowest-margin crossing assignment and the chronologically last assignment differ. Assignment order is 1D (margin 0.60), 1A (margin 0.40), 2D (margin 0.95); assigning 2D wipes out 4A. 4A is crossed by 1D and 2D only, so the backtrack target is 1D - neither the chronologically last assignment (2D) nor the lowest-margin assignment overall (1A, which does not cross 4A).
